title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked.

We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves.

DESIRED EXPERIENCE

- You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means

- Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale

- You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better

- You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build

- You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

EXAMPLE PROJECTS

- Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

- Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

- Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

- Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Engineer, you'll be a key player in our engineering organisation, a vibrant community of talented engineers spanning backend, frontend, mobile, and platform disciplines. This isn't just about maintaining; it's about innovating. You'll dive into a wide range of exciting projects, from building and integrating new APIs that elevate the customer journey to optimising our cutting-edge lending platforms. You'll also engage in deep architectural discussions, shaping the future of our products. There's ample opportunity to grow, contribute, and truly make your mark.

 

OUR MODERN TECH STACK

We believe in using the right tools for the job, and our stack reflects our commitment to modern, efficient development:

- Backend: PHP 8, Symfony, AWS, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes

- CI/CD: GitHub Actions and ArgoCD (we deploy to production as soon as a feature is complete!)

- Testing: Behat, PHPUnit for robust automated testing

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're seeking passionate engineers who are excited to contribute and grow with us:

- Strong, business oriented, engineer with modern PHP development experience (PHP 8.0+ is a must). You're fluent in the latest PHP features and best practices.

- A solid grasp of Symfony or Laravel.

- Experience with Domain Driven Design, CQRS, Message-Driven Systems, and Event Sourcing

- Familiarity with microservices architecture and working on financial systems is a bonus.

- Excellent automated testing skills (unit, integration, functional) - you believe in quality code.

- A genuine desire to learn, collaborate, and contribute your ideas within a highly collaborative team.

- High degree of ownership and autonomy

- Experience in a cross-functional environment is a plus, but not essential.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

We value your time and have designed an efficient process to get to know you:

1. A quick chat with one of our team to see if the role is a good match.

2. 15 minute cognitive assessment

3. 90 minute technical live coding exercise

4. 60 minute culture interview

LIFE AT LENDABLE

- Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

- Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

- Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

- Health coverage: support

Company Description
Swish Analytics is a sports analytics, betting and fantasy startup building the next generation of predictive sports analytics data products. We believe that oddsmaking is a challenge rooted in engineering, mathematics, and sports betting expertise; not intuition. We partner closely with infrastructure, data engineering, data science, and product teams to keep these services reliable as demand grows. title: Field Partner Sales Leader - US Federal
description:
ABOUT FACTORY

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

ABOUT THE ROLE

Factory is hiring a field partner sales leader to drive US federal revenue with the capture, account, and delivery leaders of the federal systems integrators (the primes and mid-tier FSIs), the government cloud providers (AWS GovCloud, Microsoft Azure Government, Google Public Sector), federal-focused software partners, and the reseller channel (Carahsoft as distributor plus the second-tier resellers who hold the contract vehicles). This role supports federal sales and is focused on US civilian, defense, and intelligence agencies and the partners that serve them. The leader will align with partner capture and account teams, build partner relationships at the program and agency level that produce joint pipeline, and turn early-stage partnerships into repeatable co-sell and resale.

How This Motion Builds

These are early-stage motions and partnerships, and federal adds contract vehicles, compliance gates, and a fiscal-year clock. The sequence matters:

- Make the connections. Get to the right capture leads, account executives, and practice leaders inside the primes, government clouds, software partners, and reseller channel; earn a seat in their programs.

- Win lighthouses. Land a small number of joint, referenceable wins (a pilot on an agency modernization program, an FSI using Factory in its own delivery) that prove the co-sell works in federal.

- Quantify the benefit. Instrument and document the mission outcome and the partner value (modernization acceleration, legacy code migrated, cloud consumption, contract value) so the story is credible and repeatable.

- Earn seller trust. Show partner capture and account teams that Factory helps them win and deliver programs, so co-sell becomes something they ask for.

- Then scale. Once the motion is proven, expand it through the distributor and second-tier reseller network, contract vehicles, field marketing, enablement, and formal partner programs.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

- Own federal partner revenue. Drive partner-sourced, partner-influenced, and reseller-transacted pipeline and bookings across FSIs, government clouds, software partners, and the reseller channel.

- Build capture-level relationships. Develop trusted relationships with FSI capture leads, account executives, and delivery and practice leaders, not just alliance managers, and get into joint program and agency account planning.

- Land the modernization wedge. Work with FSI, software, and cloud field teams to identify agency programs where Factory accelerates legacy modernization and cloud migration, and co-sell those opportunities to close; sell to the integrators for their own delivery work as a near-term path.

- Run the co-sell in the field. Agency and program planning, joint calls, solution narratives, teaming, deal registration, and triangulated deals (Factory + government cloud + FSI + software partner + reseller on the same program).

- Work the channel. Run the Carahsoft relationship day to day, recruit and enable second-tier resellers, route deals through the right contract vehicles (GSA MAS, NASA SEWP, CIO-SP, agency BPAs) and marketplaces, and keep quoting, pricing, and deal registration moving.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
Founded in 1999, WorldWinner develops and operates competitive games of skill with real cash prizes under the WorldWinner consumer brand and in partnership with leading Sports Gaming Entertainment company FanDuel under the FanDuel Faceoff name.
WorldWinner is the most recognized and trusted skill games technology platform and brand for players who want to Play to Win. We bring games to the world that inspire people to play for more. With over 20 challenging games where the outcome is dependent on player skills versus chance across a content library spanning classic card games to casual favorites to retro arcade games, WorldWinner has something for every gamer. Backed by Platinum Equity and strategic investors, we are building the next phase of our platform on mobile and beyond.
Supporting the SVP of Engineering, you’ll own how work flows into WorldWinner ’s central services, DevOps and data teams in a fintech-grade, real-money gaming environment. You’ll run intake and triage, keep one view of everything in flight, report clearly on what shipped and why, and automate the status-chasing out of the process. You'll also lead a small team of contract engineers covering central services and data. It’s ideal for an engineer who’d rather make the whole system run well than build one more feature. This is a contract role.
What You'll Do

• Run intake and triage for central services, DevOps and data. Decide what each request is, who it goes to, and when it’s back

• Keep one view of what's in flight across teams, so parallel work doesn't collide or spoil someone else's results

• Report what shipped, what's rolling out and what's stuck, and write the summary that explains why we chose what we chose

• Notice when work stops moving, and do something about it

• Lead a small team of contract engineers in central services and data. Set priorities, run 1:1s and give us a straight read on how they're doing

• Automate the connective tissue. Some of our systems already talk to each other and we want a lot more of it. Script against their APIs so status moves on its own instead of being chased

• Build the dashboards we don't have. One place showing the health and status of our whole landscape: the apps, the infrastructure, the data, and what's shipping. Pulled together from wherever it actually lives. That's an ambition, not a spec

• Use AI properly. We use it heavily across engineering, and expect you to as well

• Run the delivery basics: planning, commitments, retrospectives, and a clear picture of who owns what in a release

What You'll Need

• You've written and shipped software professionally, then moved toward programs and delivery. We care that you can read code, write scripts and talk to engineers as a peer - not which languages you used

• You automate your own work - calling APIs, wiring tools together, building the report rather than asking for it

• You use AI tools seriously, and have a view on where they help and where they don't

• You've owned delivery or release reporting for a team that ships regularly

• You've led engineers before, even a small group. We're not asking for a career manager, we're asking for someone people will follow

• Good judgment about what's urgent and what's only loud

• Clear writing. Most of this job happens in writing

• Calm under pressure, and the kind of presence that makes people bring you problems early

Nice to Have But Not Necessary

• Live-service, real-money or regulated-product experience

• Mobile release management - Apple App Store, Google Play

• Administering Jira or Confluence

• Incident response and on-call practice

• AWS or another cloud provider

A Note on Applying
If you can do most of this, we'd like to hear from you. We'd rather talk to someone strong in four of these areas than someone who ticks every box.

title: Member of Scientific Staff, Protein Production
description: LOCATION: King's Cross, London · PATTERN: Lab-based, full-time The opportunity We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders. This role sits at the start of our protein work. Every measurement we make depends on the protein in the well being the right one, made the same way every time, and you would be one of the people making it. About us AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one. We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team. The role You will make proteins, many of them at once. The work runs from DNA through to purified, quality-checked protein in 96-well format, ready for the binding and biophysical assays downstream of you. On the DNA side you will prepare expression templates from synthetic gene fragments, by PCR and by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and check them before they go forward. You will express proteins in cell-free systems first, with E. coli and mammalian (HEK293) expression following as the menu grows. You will purify them by affinity capture, mostly on magnetic beads in plates, and confirm what you made with quantification, CE-SDS and SEC. title: KIP Spring 2027 - Legislative Intern - Citizens Against Government Waste

description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

Citizens Against Government Waste (CAGW) offers a wide variety of opportunities to college students across the country. Unpaid research, communications, and government affairs internships are available on a year-round basis and can vary in length from a semester to a few weeks in duration. Interns can choose to work part-time or full-time, as hours of work are extremely flexible. Our daily work with Capitol Hill and the White House, as well as government agencies and other nonprofit organizations, provides a close and invaluable look at how Washington works. Since CAGW maintains a small staff, interns gain hands-on experience in all aspects of CAGW’s activities. Many projects involve working closely with staff members, while others require a great deal of independence. Interns are considered important members of our staff and actively participate in staff meetings and other events. While interns will also be required to perform clerical duties from time to time, much of the work will be substantive.
 
Research Internship
Assist in formulating policy papers and collect data for original investigative studies. Research and write for CAGW’s annual publications, which include the Congressional Pig Book, Prime Cuts, Government WasteWatch eNews, and special projects, including issue briefs, and policy papers. Interns will have the opportunity to initiate projects. Research internships are also available in specific areas, including healthcare and science, technology and telecommunications, federal regulations and taxation.

Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. Senior Program Manager - DCPDS

Leidos is seeking an accomplished Senior Program Manager (PM) to lead the operation, sustainment, modernization, and lifecycle management of the Defense Civilian Personnel Data System (DCPDS), a mission-critical enterprise human resources platform supporting Department of Defense and non-DoD organizations. The DCPDS program provides operational support, maintenance, versioning, upgrades, modernization, and continuous improvement across a complex suite of enterprise HR applications and supporting environments. The program supports DoD Components including the Air Force, Army, Navy, Defense Finance and Accounting Service (DFAS), Defense Logistics Agency (DLA), and National Guard, as well as non-DoD customers including the Executive Office of the President (EOP) and the United States Agency for Global Media (USAGM).

The environment includes DCPDS production, SQT environments and on production environments as well as Reduced Sign-On (RSO), MyBiz+, MyPerformance, Corporate Management Information System (CMIS), Current Record Mart (CRM/NDCRM), SAP Business Intelligence/Business Objects (BOBJ), External Interface Transfer System (EXITS), and associated interfaces, databases, infrastructure, cybersecurity, test, and support capabilities.

Success requires more than traditional program management. The DCPDS PM must be a mission-focused, technically credible leader who can integrate operations, application sustainment, infrastructure, cybersecurity, testing, modernization, contractual, and financial priorities while maintaining strong customer confidence and positioning the program for continued growth and future modernization.

Lead Overall DCPDS Program Performance

Ensure program activities, task plans, deliverables, staffing, schedules, and costs remain aligned to contractual requirements and customer mission priorities.

Success looks like: DCPDS operational, technical, contractual, financial, and schedule commitments are consistently achieved; ownership is clear across the organization; and emerging risks are addressed before they materially affect mission delivery or customer confidence.

Integrate DCPDS Operations, Sustainment and Modernization

title: Principal Applied Scientist (User Modeling)

The Agentic Foundations team is a focused group of 15-20 applied scientists within Zillow’s broader Agentic AI organization, building the foundational AI technologies that power the next generation of home shopping experiences. • Independently drive complex work end-to-end by collaborating across partner teams.

Must-haves

• PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field, with depth in reinforcement learning or causal inference.

Nice-to-haves

This person will be our eyes on the ground for feedback on creative, messaging audiences, and general client flows with conversion rates. This creates a very dynamic role for the Rubato Google Ads Manager.
Day to Day:

• Is married to the data looking at trendlines across every relevant event and metric on every account.

• Doesn’t wait for performance to show up or not show up in ROAS, but rather identifies early indicators of success or failure and reacts accordingly.

• Doesn't just recognize a problem, but then forms a hypothesis why and presents possible solutions.

• Works very closely with our Head of Media, Creative Director and Client Growth Director to make sure all the data “on the ground” is communicated to other pertinent areas of Rubato for well executed client calls, building out Rubato’s 3 levels of client media plans (12-mo. Growth Plan, Quarterly Plan, 30-day Plan), new creative & messaging sets needed, etc…

• Is involved in the overall media strategy, communicating new ideas and areas of possible growth to the media team lead.

• Stays in the loop on the client Slack workspaces to ensure nothing falls through the cracks and is aware of any upcoming promos, events, etc. that would have an impact on media strategy.

• Sets up all campaigns in Google Ads Platform and uses Editor for speed.

• Constantly looks for ways to improve the accounts on a granular level and ensures we are conforming to best practices or core strategies. Our creative team will have all creatives ready to go in mock campaigns. This person pulls in the creatives & messaging to test across audiences they have developed and setup.

• Will be part of a cross-functional team, working closely with both our media team and client growth team to deliver the best results for our clients

• Knows Google Ads’ interfaces inside & out

• Hyper data-focused and easily able to understand the mathematics on main media metrics (CTR, CR, CPM, ROAS, any comparison percentages etc.)

• Understands the importance of looking at data on a trendline

• Able to look at data on the media/creative level and understand what is going well, what is not going well, and where to focus efforts for improvement

• Easily navigate, manipulate & analyze data in Excel or Google Sheets

• Able to think about marketing for our clients’ businesses from a whole--how does what we are doing on the media side fit into their goals? Their other initiatives?

• Still fun to work with, even though a data person ;)

Other Cool Things:
Be where you want to be, when you want to be there. We currently have team members living in the US, Canada, Spain, and Argentina. As long as you’re cool working roughly on Eastern Standard Time, you’re good to go.
Even though we aren’t in a physical office space, our team is close and connected. We collaborate daily through video calls and seek to create a fun, positive work environment. We also have team events around the world in which we physically come together to work, and play! You are encouraged to bring new ideas to the table daily, sharing information is key to our personal and business growth.
In addition to a salary of $50K to $75K, Rubato offers two weeks paid vacation annually plus an open policy on vacation requests.
If you are interested in this position, please apply! We look forward to hearing from you!

Lieu de travail : IMT Nord Europe - Douai, site Lahure (déplacements ponctuels à Mines Saint-Étienne et à Clermont-Ferrand)
Contexte :
École sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.
IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.
Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».
Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr
Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre d’Enseignement, de Recherche et d’Innovation Systèmes Numériques (CERI SN) d’IMT Nord Europe. Le CERI SN mène des recherches en informatique, intelligence artificielle, systèmes multi-agents, recherche opérationnelle et aide à la décision, avec un fort ancrage applicatif dans l’industrie du futur, la logistique et les jumeaux numériques.
Missions :
Le/la post-doctorant(e) sera recruté(e) dans le cadre du projet ANR ReCircle (AAPG 2025, 2026-2030), porté par Mines Saint-Étienne (LIMOS), IMT Nord Europe (CERI SN) et l’Université Clermont Auvergne (LIMOS). ReCircle vise à développer des méthodes d’aide à la décision en temps réel pour les chaînes logistiques inverses de remanufacturing, en intégrant l’ordonnancement dynamique des opérations de désassemblage/réassemblage et la gestion des tournées avec collecte et livraison (Inventory Routing Problem with Pickup and Delivery, IRP-PD), tout en prenant en compte des critères environnementaux (émissions de CO₂) et humains (fatigue, ergonomie).
La mission principale du/de la post-doctorant(e) est de faire converger les travaux des deux thèses du projet vers un problème intégré et dynamique « IRP-PD & remanufacturing » (WP4), de contribuer au cas d’usage de référence (WP5) et de préparer l’intégration des méthodes développées dans une preuve de concept de jumeau numérique (WP6). Le poste est co-encadré par IMT Nord Europe et Mines Saint-Étienne.

The Design System team owns Click UI - the open-source Design System of ClickHouse. It is the shared UI foundation for ClickHouse Cloud and several other projects. - Research, build, and maintain accessible React components and their APIs on headless accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) primitives. Keyboard interaction, focus management, and theming are part of each component from the start.

- Work on the library enhancements, focusing on consistent and intuitive components API and developer experience improvements. Enable complex migrations with codemods and semantic versioning.

- Maintain the shared reliable infrastructure: Storybook, unit, interaction E2E and visual regression tests, accessibility gates, and a reliable release process.

- Drive adoption: high quality documentation, usage guidelines, migration guides, issue intake and triage (including open-source issues), and code review with product teams.

- Build the AI-assisted layer: Figma-to-code, component scaffolding, and guardrails that keep AI-generated UI on-token, on-pattern, and accessible.

- Experience: 6+ years of frontend engineering. You have built or maintained a production design system that multiple teams use, including its migrations and breaking changes.

Experience with component API design (atomic design, composition, controlled and uncontrolled, polymorphic patterns) and headless primitives such as React Aria, Ark UI or Radix.

- System Mindset: You treat the design system as a product with internal customers. You write clear documentation, review for consistency across the library, and mentor through code review. You measure success by adoption, not by component count. You are fluent in Figma and use AI coding tools (for example Claude Code or Cursor).

- Ideal Backgrounds: Design system or UI/UX platform teams at developer tools, B2B SaaS, or cloud platforms, or frontend platform roles with a shared UI library and multi-team consumers.

title: Project Management, Senior Associate
description:
Job Title: Project Management, Senior Associate
Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission-to serve patients living with serious illnesses-drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
Project Management, Senior Associate
What you will do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will coordinate scientific data and support key business functions. The successful candidate will organize and quality-check data for sharing, coordinate cross-functional work, and improve manual processes in partnership with scientists, data management resources, and business and functional teams. The role requires sound judgment, reliable follow-through, and the ability to identify when decisions or approvals need to be escalated.
This is a remote role, reporting directly to the Strategic Planning and Operations Sr. Manager, TSRS. Occasional travel (up to 20% of the time) could be required.
Responsibilities:
· Compile scientific data into approved tools, templates or formats for sharing; check records for completeness, consistency, and alignment with agreed requirements.
· Manage requests for scientific data by working with scientists and data owners to identify systems and tools to streamline data procurement from enterprise-wide source locations.
· Coordinate approved exchanges of data with internal and external partners, confirming that required content, approvals, and transfer steps are complete and escalating questions about data selection, permissions, or release decisions to the appropriate owners.
· Coordinate activities for internal initiatives and extramural memberships, including scheduling meetings, preparing agendas and follow-up notes, and tracking actions through completion.
· Build business information tools by gathering user needs, documenting process and system requirements, coordinating prioritization, participating in testing, and helping prepare instructions or training for new tools.
· Identify repetitive or manual workflows that may be improved through modernization or automation.
· Maintain visibility to financial trackers, monitor commitments and actual spending, and flag discrepancies or forecast variances for management review.
What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The organized professional we seek is a collaborative partner with these qualifications.
Basic Qualifications:
Master’s degree
OR
Bachelor’s degree and 2 years of project coordination, technical operations, or process administration experience, in Life Sciences
OR
Associate’s degree and 6 years of project coordination, technical operations, or process administration experience, in Life Sciences
OR
High school diploma / GED and 8 years of project coordination, technical operations, or process administration experience, in Life Sciences
Preferred Qualifications:
· Ability to build effective working relationships and collaborate across scientific, operational, and cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment.

title: Technical Consultant
description:
Cayenta, a division of Harris ; is seeking a Technical Consultant who will join our Cayenta Managed Services (CMS) team within Managed Services & Technical Operations.
As a Technical Consultant, you will help manage and maintain the technical environments that support our customers' Cayenta ERP and Customer Information Systems. You will work across system administration, database administration, troubleshooting, maintenance, monitoring, customer support, and eventually cloud infrastructure.
This is a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning how systems work, and taking ownership of customer environments. You will initially focus primarily on on-premises customer environments, with opportunities to expand into Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud operations as the Managed Services offering continues to grow.
You will work closely with other Managed Services team members as well as Cayenta Support, Technical Services, Development, Business Intelligence, and other teams to maintain reliable, secure, and stable customer environments.
This may be the most important section of this job description. Read it carefully before applying.
Technical knowledge can be developed. Curiosity, resourcefulness, and ownership are much harder to teach.
We are looking for someone who is hungry to learn, willing to dig, and comfortable solving problems that don't come with step-by-step instructions.
In Managed Services, you will encounter unfamiliar configurations, technical issues you haven't seen before, incomplete documentation, and situations where the first answer you try doesn't work.
When you hit that wall, we don't expect you to already know everything.
We do expect you to keep going.
Search the internal knowledge base. Read the product and vendor documentation. Review previous tickets. Look at logs. Compare environments. Test safely. Ask knowledgeable teammates better questions. Use AI tools responsibly to help research, reason through possibilities, interpret information, and accelerate troubleshooting.
If one path doesn't work, try another.
And when you solve something new, document what you learned so the next person doesn't have to start from zero.
We are not looking for someone whose troubleshooting process ends with "I checked the KB and couldn't find it." We are looking for someone who sees that as the beginning of the investigation.
Ask yourself: when you last encountered a technical problem with no obvious answer, what did you do next?
If your instinct was to follow every reasonable lead until you understood what was happening, you may be exactly who we're looking for.
We are committed to using emerging technologies to improve how we work, solve problems, and support our customers.
The successful candidate will be comfortable incorporating AI-enabled tools, copilots, chat-based assistants, scripting, and automation into their everyday work where appropriate.
AI should accelerate good technical thinking-not replace it. Team members are expected to validate outputs, protect customer and company information, and follow applicable security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
You will serve as a primary or secondary technical consultant for multiple Cayenta Managed Services customers and help ensure their environments remain reliable, secure, stable, and well maintained.
This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US.
